About Super Mandala Lab

Super Mandala Lab is a free mandala maker. You can draw a mandala, print it as a coloring page, or download a cut file for a Cricut, laser cutter or plasma table, without making an account or paying for exports.

It's made by SuperFabLab, a metal fabrication studio in Reno, Nevada that cuts decorative panels and lanterns from steel. Most free mandala tools stop at a picture. We wanted one that also makes files a machine can cut: real closed shapes, at real sizes, with a warning before a design falls apart into loose pieces.

Free, and staying free

Every format is free to download, with no watermark. Your designs are yours to use, including on things you sell.

Get in touch

Ideas, bugs or something you made with the maker? We'd love to hear about it through SuperFabLab.
